title: Power fluctuations in Ilocos Norte traced to NGCP's low voltage supply

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The Ilocos Norte Electric Cooperative Inc. (INEC) has traced reports of fluctuating electricity supply in the province to low voltage delivery from the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). In an advisory Friday (Nov. 6), INEC stated that its investigation of power lines and electrical systems found the fluctuations were caused by low voltage delivery from NGCP. READ: ERC hits 13 gencos with show-cause orders over outages According to NGCP, the low voltage condition was triggered by the rapid increase in the megawatt (MW) output of renewable energy companies operating in the Ilocos region.
